content: अमवत् {%a.%} <ab>Ved.</ab> .²1 Violent, strong, stormy (winds); powerful (sound also). .²2 Persevering, constant. .²3 Capable, fit, proper. .²4 Attended by ministers. .²5 Attended by diseases. .²6 Possessed of self. --{%ind.%} Violently, impetuously; य आश्वश्वा अमवद् वहन्त <ls>Rv. 5. 58. 1</ls>.
